acceptedInterpretation: Unify host-side LLM usage capture into the single existing ledger (.lattice/usage/llm-usage.jsonl) via one launcher choke point. M1 (milestones M1-CAPTURE/M1-COVERAGE/M1-GUIDANCE, checklist CHK-001..004) adds a host_run command that launches codex/claude/agy through the B-d8ef canonical launcher argv and writes correlated preflight+final usage rows bound to storyId/agentType/phase/provider (plus reviewRunId/lane where relevant), extends the same seam to the remaining lattice-initiated spawns (autopilot repair, readiness probes, cross-host codex leaf), and routes operator guidance through the choke point; codex usage is parsed from the exec --json turn.completed event (canonical runs are --ephemeral so no rollout is written), claude from stream-json result usage, and agy records usage.source=unavailable because it exposes no per-call usage surface. T2 (M1-CAPS/CHK-007) adds a fail-closed per-dispatch hard-budget cap and a host-run concurrency cap that refuse over-limit runs before spawn and write diagnostics-honest blocked rows. M2 (M2-SWEEP/CHK-005) adds a strictly read-only usage_sweep that scans ~/.codex/sessions rollouts and ~/.claude/projects transcripts since a cutoff and emits a clearly NON-AUTHORITATIVE per-session attribution report (token totals + story mentions + cwd) for sessions lattice did not launch. Non-goals hold throughout: usage stays gateEvidence=false diagnostics, the sweep never backfills the ledger, and interactive desktop sessions are report-only and never intercepted; QA-WIRING/CHK-006 binds the two fixture smokes, npm scripts and docs that verify all of the above.
notes: Independent intent-collision review. Checked snapshot sourceText/normalizedOutcome/acceptanceClaim against 6 milestones + 7 checklist items + plan.md + background.md. (a) M1 choke-point capture with storyId/agentType/phase/provider binding = M1-CAPTURE/CHK-001 (+reviewRunId/lane CHK-002); (b) read-only non-authoritative sweep = M2-SWEEP/CHK-005 (excludes: no backfill, no gate read); (c) per-dispatch budget + concurrency caps = M1-CAPS/CHK-007 fail-closed pre-spawn blocked rows; (d) non-goals preserved (gateEvidence=false + no desktop interception in CHK-001 excludes and plan design anchors). The two assumption corrections are FAITHFUL evidence-backed refinements, not collisions: agy-unavailable honors the user's own 'if any' hedge (B-fbb6 re-probed 2026-07-10, records unavailable rather than fabricating counts), and codex-usage-from-exec-json-stdout preserves exactly the four fields the user named while correctly sourcing them given the canonical --ephemeral launcher (rollout parsing correctly retained for M2 desktop/foreign sessions only). Coverage-wiring warns from intent_coverage_check (unknown verificationIntent refs, missing acceptance binding) are orthogonal non-blocking schema diagnostics, not interpretation collisions.
